subject: general
question: India is the ______ producer of pulses and the ______ consumer of pulses
solution:
The correct answer is __**largest, largest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is the largest producer, importer and consumer of pulses in the world accounting for nearly **25% of global production, 15% of International trade and 27% of world consumption.**
 
• Various types of pulses imported are** Tur Whole (Pigeon Peas), Black Matpe (Urad), Green Moong, Chick Peas and Yellow Peas.**
 
• **India is the largest producer of Jute.**
 
• India is the largest producer of Sugar (As of 2023).
 
• **Gujarat is the largest producer of salt in the country.**
